comment: Declared codes 120930 (herbaceous perennial seed for sowing) and 120991 (vegetable seed for sowing) are directionally correct and cover the bulk of the catalogue: all the tomato/brinjal/chilli/cucumber/gourd/cabbage/cauliflower/radish/onion/carrot/okra/pepper/watermelon/muskmelon lines are vegetable seed for sowing -> 120991. Status: partial, because the declaration is incomplete rather than wrong. Missing from the declaration: (1) 120600 sunflower seed and 120750 mustard / 120740 sesame / 120799 other oil seeds - not evidenced on site, so not asserted; (2) 120921-120929-120999 other agricultural seeds for sowing, which is where the site's non-vegetable lines fall: coriander (Green Aroma, Tejas) and spinach (Chitra, Karuna, Titan-111) are 120991 only if treated as vegetable seed, otherwise 120999; annual ryegrass (Lolium) is fodder/grass seed -> 120925/120929; chicory (Commander) -> 120930 or 120999; marigold (Tagetes) seed -> 120930 (herbaceous perennial) or 120999; peas (Tiger, Green Valley, Polo, Apoorva 55, PSM-3, AP-3, Super Arkel) -> 071310 if whole dried peas, but as sowing seed 120991/120999; cowpea/dolichos/cluster bean sowing seed -> 120991 or 071331/071333 if dried leguminous vegetables. (3) If any produce (not seed) is traded - e.g. fresh tomato 070200, onion 070310, cabbage/cauliflower 070490, chilli/pepper 070960, pumpkin/squash 070993, other fresh vegetables 070999 - those codes are absent from the declaration; the site presents only seed, so this is not asserted. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification: this is agricultural seed / agri-inputs (R&D, hybrid seed production, contract seed production), not food or FMCG. Trader signs: the site mixes own-brand hybrid varieties (GS-prefixed, e.g. GS-8585 F, G.S. 111, GS X 36 F1) with a very long third-party-looking variety list and offers 'contract production' and 'R&D opportunities', which is consistent with a seed marketer plus contract multiplier rather than a pure breeder - hence manufacturer_trader. Entity/geography discrepancy: the claimed state is Gujarat and the claimed legal person is Arvind Kumar, but the only website found under this name (globalseedsindia.com) shows a Delhi contact number (+91 11-45027135) and brand 'Global F&F Seeds'; no page on the site was reachable to confirm the registered name, CIN, PAN or state (about-us.html and contact-us.html returned 404; only contact.html loaded). Therefore the link between the website and the specific legal entity 'GLOBAL SEEDS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED' is NOT confirmed - treat the product mapping as indicative only. All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no customs line, shipping bill or GST record was checked in this task (out of scope), so no product is corroborated by a shipment record. No HS-based rejection: company retained, code set corrected/expanded to 120991 + 120930 + 120999/120929 as applicable.
